US Imposes Sanctions on Iran Amid Tensions After Missile Attack

The US has imposed sanctions on Iran amid tensions following a missile attack that occurred after the withdrawal of American forces from the region. The move comes as President Trump announces plans to increase military presence in Turkey. The situation highlights ongoing regional instability and the complex relationships between major world powers.
